question: Where are a museum within 140 kilometers from Ghostprint Gallery, Richmond, VA on the east side?
sql: WITH gallery_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Ghostprint Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Richmond%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, gallery_location AS gl WHERE (p.museum IS TRUE OR p.tourism ILIKE '%museum%') AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, gl.geometry::geography, 140000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(gl.geometry), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
